title: Tropical Storm Florence - SCNG Responds
description: U.S. Army Spc. Devon Duncan and Sgt. Stephen Elison assigned to the 1055th Transportation Company, 228th Theatre Tactical Signal Brigade, South Carolina Army National Guard, refuel a SCNG LMTV, from the 1178th Forward Support Company deployed from Myrtle Beach, at the Bennettsville Armory, S.C., in preparation for additional high-water evacuations of local civilians. (U.S. National Guard photo by Senior Master Sgt. Edward Snyder)
